models-auto 501, 502, 503, 506, 507 and the second 504/505 items (Q2081673, Q132529265, Q132529267, Q132529271, Q132529274, Q132529276, Q132529280) are frwiki/Commons 'Peugeot Type 50x' items without manufacturer data; the Wikidata/Wikipedia API rate-limited this run, so it is not settled whether they are cars, cycles or duplicates of 504/505.
models-auto ex3 (Q7179478 'former French automobile') and dk5 (Q133444935) could not be identified; ex3 is likely a pre-WWI Grand Prix/Coupe de l'Auto car.
Line '301' mixes the pre-war 301 (1932-1936) and the 2012 sedan in one card; model-lines-auto has from 2012 only. Consider separate lines.
Line '408' card covers only the 2022 crossover (P54); the 2010/2014 China/Latin America 408 sedans are not carded.
Lines boxer and expert (vans) still have no card; bipper card added without photo.
205 GTI trims (84 kW for 115 PS, 95 kW for 130 PS) look truncated rather than rounded (84.6, 95.6) but no second source was checked; left as is.
Type 2 (1890) end year and units remain unknown; RCZ facelift year not confirmed (left null).
Facelift stages were added without photos; the model-cards index (scripts/model-cards-index.mjs) has not been rebuilt (shared file).
summary: Peugeot cards: production status/end years fixed (2008, 208, 308, 3008, 5008, 408 current; 508 R83 ended May 2025; 3008 P84 and 5008 P87 ended 2024), facelift stages added to 30+ generations, codes for 508 (W23/R83) and 408 (P54), Partner split into M49/B9/K9, classic end years and body types fixed, five corrupted Czech photo notes repaired, Bipper card added. Proposals: 79 line fixes, 37 models-auto removals/merges, Rifter missing from models-auto.
